definitions.explanation: A tropical storm occurring in the western Pacific Ocean.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
{台風|たいふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Trains stopped due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of the typhoon.

notes:
{台風|たいふう} is a tropical cyclone in the western Pacific, common in Japan from August to October.

NAMING:
In Japan, typhoons are numbered sequentially each year: {台風|たいふう}⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{号|ごう}→〜号：04024_gou⟧ (Typhoon #10).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {台風|たいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧/⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: a typhoon is coming/approaching
- {台風|たいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a typhoon makes landfall
- {台風|たいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: a typhoon passes
- {台風|たいふう}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: typhoon information

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暴風雨|ぼうふうう}→暴風雨：07670_boufuuu⟧: storm
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧: evacuation
